description:
**Present perfect continuous**（现在完成进行时）

**用法**：have/has been + V-ing。表从过去持续到现在的动作，强调过程。

**例句**：
- I've been waiting for an hour.
- She has been studying all morning.
- How long have you been working here?

**常见错误**：
- has been 后接过去分词
- has been 与 has gone 混淆

**辨析**：现在完成进行时 vs. 现在完成时：过程 vs. 结果。

**Past perfect**（过去完成时）

**用法**：had + 过去分词。表过去某一时间之前发生的动作。

**例句**：
- When I arrived, she had already left.
- I had never seen such a beautiful place.
- He had finished before I came.

**常见错误**：
- 过去完成时与过去式顺序颠倒
- had 后接过去式

**注意**：过去完成时 = 过去的过去。

**Past perfect continuous**（过去完成进行时）

**用法**：had been + V-ing。表过去某时之前一直持续的动作。

**例句**：
- I had been working for two hours when he called.
- She was tired because she had been running.
- They had been living there for years.

**常见错误**：
- had been 后接过去分词
- had been 与 was/were 混用

**注意**：过去完成进行时强调持续到过去某时的过程。

**Future continuous**（将来进行时）

**用法**：will be + V-ing。表将来某时正在进行的动作。

**例句**：
- This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Paris.
- At 8 p.m., we'll be having dinner.
- Will you be working tomorrow?

**常见错误**：
- will be 后接过去分词
- 将来进行时与 be going to 混用

**注意**：将来进行时表将来某时的背景动作。

**Future perfect**（将来完成时）

**用法**：will have + 过去分词。表将来某时之前完成的动作。

**例句**：
- By next year, I'll have graduated.
- She will have finished by 6 p.m.
- They will have left by the time we arrive.

**常见错误**：
- 将来完成时与将来时混用
- will have 后接动词原形

**注意**：by + 将来时间 → will have done。

**Future perfect continuous**（将来完成进行时）

**用法**：will have been + V-ing。表到将来某时一直持续的动作。

**例句**：
- By July, I'll have been working here for ten years.
- She will have been studying for six hours.

**常见错误**：
- will have been 后接过去分词
- 与将来完成时混淆

**注意**：将来完成进行时强调持续到将来某时的过程。

**Mixed conditionals**（混合条件句）

**用法**：第二/第三条件句混合，if 从句与主句时间不同。

**例句**：
- If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. (过去→现在)
- If I were rich, I would have bought a house. (现在→过去)

**常见错误**：
- if 从句与主句时态不匹配
- would have 后接现在式

**注意**：混合条件句需根据时间选择对应时态。

**Third conditional**（第三条件句）

**用法**：If + had + 过去分词, would have + 过去分词。表过去不可能。

**例句**：
- If I had known, I would have told you.
- She would have passed if she had studied.
- If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.

**常见错误**：
- if 从句用 would have
- 主句用 had + 过去分词

**注意**：第三条件句：与过去事实相反。

grammar: Modal verbs of deduction: must, can't, might, may
description:
**Modal verbs of deduction: must, can't, might, may**（情态动词表推测）

**用法**：must 肯定推测；can't 否定推测；might/may 可能。

**例句**：
- He must be tired.
- It can't be true.
- She might be at home.

**常见错误**：
- must 的否定用 mustn't（应为 can't）
- might 与 must 程度混淆

**注意**：must > may > might > can't（肯定→否定）。

grammar: Modal verbs of obligation: must, should, ought to, have to
description:
**Modal verbs of obligation: must, should, ought to, have to**（义务情态动词）

**用法**：must 强烈主观；have to 客观；should/ought to 建议。

**例句**：
- You must finish this today.
- You should apologise.
- You ought to see a doctor.

**常见错误**：
- ought to 后接 to 忘记
- should 与 must 语气不分

**注意**：ought to = should，语气稍强。

grammar: Modal verbs of permission: can, could, may, might
description:
**Modal verbs of permission: can, could, may, might**（许可情态动词）

**用法**：can 日常许可；could/may 更礼貌；might 最委婉/不确定。

**例句**：
- Can I use your phone?
- May I come in?
- Could I borrow this book?

**常见错误**：
- May 后接动词原形错误
- can 与 may 在请求中完全等同

**注意**：may 更正式；could 更礼貌。

grammar: Modal verbs of ability: can, could, be able to, manage to
description:
**Modal verbs of ability: can, could, be able to, manage to**（能力情态动词）

**用法**：can 现在能力；could 过去能力；be able to 可用于各种时态；manage to 表成功做到。

**例句**：
- I can swim.
- I was able to finish on time.
- She managed to escape.

**常见错误**：
- could 表过去具体能力时常用 was able to
- managed to 与 could 混用

**注意**：managed to 强调经过努力成功。

grammar: Modal verbs of advice: should, ought to, had better
description:
**Modal verbs of advice: should, ought to, had better**（建议情态动词）

**用法**：should/ought to 建议；had better 警告/强烈建议（不做会有后果）。

**例句**：
- You should take a break.
- You'd better not be late.
- You ought to see a dentist.

**常见错误**：
- had better 后接 to
- had better 与 should 语气不分

**注意**：had better 不做有负面后果。

**Reported speech with modal verbs**（间接引语与情态动词）

**用法**：must, need, should, could 等在间接引语中常变化。

**例句**：
- 'You must leave,' he said. → He said (that) I had to leave.
- 'You can go,' she said. → She said (that) I could go.
- 'I will help,' he said. → He said (that) he would help.

**常见错误**：
- must 在间接引语中仍用 must（可能变化）
- will 不变 would

**注意**：must 若表必须，间接引语常用 had to；表推测时可用 must。

**Passive voice (all tenses)**（全被动语态）

**用法**：所有时态都有被动形式：is done, was done, has been done, will be done。

**例句**：
- The project is being discussed now.
- The report has been finished.
- The meeting will be held tomorrow.

**常见错误**：
- 被动语态中漏掉 be 或过去分词
- 进行时被动语态结构错误

**注意**：被动语态：be + 过去分词，be 体现时态。

**Passive voice with two objects**（双宾语被动语态）

**用法**：give/show/tell/send 等可有两个宾语，均可变被动。

**例句**：
- She gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
- They showed us the way. → We were shown the way.

**常见错误**：
- 双宾语被动漏 to/for
- 主动间接宾语与直接宾语位置错

**注意**：give sb sth = give sth to sb。

**Impersonal passive (It is said that...)**（非人称被动）

**用法**：It is said/believed/known that... / He is said to...

**例句**：
- It is said that he is rich.
- He is said to be rich.
- It is believed that she left.

**常见错误**：
- He is said to be 后接动词原形（应为 to be/完成式）
- It is said 后接 that 漏掉

**注意**：sb is said to be/do/have done。

**Causative have/get (review)**（使役 have/get 复习）

**用法**：have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词；get 比 have 更口语。

**例句**：
- I got my hair cut.
- He had his car stolen.
- We need to get this fixed.

**常见错误**：
- have/get 后接 doing 表被动
- have 与 make 使役混淆

**注意**：make sb do sth 不带 to；have/get sth done。

**Relative clauses: non-defining**（非限定性定语从句）

**用法**：用逗号隔开，提供额外信息，不可用 that。

**例句**：
- My mother, who is 60, lives in Paris.
- The Eiffel Tower, which is in Paris, is famous.
- Tom, whose brother is a doctor, arrived late.

**常见错误**：
- 非限定从句用 that
- 漏掉逗号

**注意**：非限定从句中关系代词不能省略。

**Relative clauses: whose**（whose 定语从句）

**用法**：whose 表所属，可指人也可指物。

**例句**：
- The man whose car was stolen is here.
- I met a woman whose son is a doctor.
- The house whose roof is red is mine.

**常见错误**：
- whose 与 who's 混淆
- whose 只能指人

**注意**：whose = of which/whom。

**Relative clauses: where / when / why**（where / when / why 定语从句）

**用法**：where 地点，when 时间，why 原因。

**例句**：
- This is the town where I was born.
- Do you remember the day when we met?
- That's the reason why I left.

**常见错误**：
- where 前加 in/at（多余）
- why 前加 for（多余）

**注意**：the reason why 中 why 可省略。

**Reduced relative clauses**（简化定语从句）

**用法**：用现在分词或过去分词短语简化定语从句。

**例句**：
- The man sitting next to me is a doctor. (= who is sitting)
- The book written by her is popular. (= which was written)
- People living in cities are busy.

**常见错误**：
- 简化后保留关系代词
- 过去分词与现在分词混淆

**注意**：主动关系用 doing，被动关系用 done。

**Participle clauses**（分词短语）

**用法**：现在分词/过去分词短语作状语，表时间、原因、条件等。

**例句**：
- Walking home, I saw an accident. (时间/原因)
- Seen from above, the city looks small. (条件)
- Feeling tired, she went to bed. (原因)

**常见错误**：
- 分词短语主语与主句主语不一致
- 分词短语后接完整句子

**注意**：分词短语逻辑主语需与主句主语一致。

**Gerund vs. infinitive after verbs**（动名词 vs. 不定式（动词后））

**用法**：stop, remember, forget, try, regret, mean, go on 等后接 doing/to do 意义不同。

**例句**：
- I stopped smoking. (停止做)
- I stopped to smoke. (停下来去做)
- I remember meeting him. (记得做过)
- I remembered to meet him. (记得要去做)

**常见错误**：
- stop 后接 to do 与 doing 意义混淆
- remember 后接 to do 与 doing 混淆

**注意**：remember doing 记得做过；remember to do 记得去做。

**Gerund vs. infinitive as subject**（动名词 vs. 不定式（主语））

**用法**：Doing sth 作主语更常见；To do sth 作主语表具体/目的。

**例句**：
- Swimming is good for your health.
- To finish on time is important.
- It is important to finish on time. (更自然)

**常见错误**：
- 动词原形作主语
- 不定式主语用 it 作形式主语时结构错

**注意**：It's + adj + to do 是更自然结构。

grammar: Verb patterns: want / would like / need / enjoy / refuse
description:
**Verb patterns: want / would like / need / enjoy / refuse**（动词搭配）

**用法**：want to do, would like to do, need to do, enjoy doing, refuse to do。

**例句**：
- I want to go.
- She enjoys reading.
- He refused to help.

**常见错误**：
- enjoy 后接 to do
- want 后接 doing

**注意**：固定搭配需记忆。

**Verb patterns: make/let/help**（make/let/help 动词搭配）

**用法**：make/let + 宾语 + 动词原形；help + 宾语 + (to) do。

**例句**：
- She made me laugh.
- Let me help you.
- He helped me (to) carry the box.

**常见错误**：
- make 后接 to do
- let 后接 to do

**注意**：make/let 后接不带 to 的不定式。

**Verb patterns: suggest / recommend / advise**（suggest/recommend/advise 动词搭配）

**用法**：suggest/recommend + doing；advise + sb + to do。

**例句**：
- I suggest leaving early.
- I recommend trying this.
- She advised me to see a doctor.

**常见错误**：
- suggest 后接 to do
- recommend 后接 to do

**注意**：suggest that + 主语 + (should) do。

**Adjective + that clause**（形容词 + that 从句）

**用法**：It is important/necessary/strange that + (should) + 动词。

**例句**：
- It is important that you be on time. (美)
- It is strange that he should say that.
- It is necessary that she come early.

**常见错误**：
- should 省略时误以为语法错误
- that 从句用 should 时误用 would

**注意**：虚拟语气中 should 可省略。

**Subjunctive mood**（虚拟语气）

**用法**：wish, if only, as if, would rather, it's time 后的非真实形式。

**例句**：
- I wish I were rich.
- It's time we left.
- He acts as if he knew everything.

**常见错误**：
- wish 后接 will
- as if 后接 will

**注意**：虚拟语气中 be 常用 were。

**Would rather / would sooner**（would rather）

**用法**：would rather + 动词原形；would rather + 从句用过去式。

**例句**：
- I'd rather stay home.
- I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
- I'd sooner walk than drive.

**常见错误**：
- would rather 后接 to do
- would rather 从句中用现在时

**注意**：would rather 从句用过去式表虚拟。

**It's time + past simple**（It's time...）

**用法**：It's time (for sb) to do；It's time + 从句用过去式。

**例句**：
- It's time to go.
- It's time for bed.
- It's time you went to bed.

**常见错误**：
- It's time 从句用现在时
- It's time 后接 for 与 to 混淆

**注意**：It's time + 从句用过去式表虚拟。

**As if / as though**（as if / as though）

**用法**：表好像，后接过去式或过去完成式表虚拟。

**例句**：
- He behaves as if he were the boss.
- It looks as if it's going to rain.
- She talks as though she knew everything.

**常见错误**：
- as if 后接 will
- as if 与 like 混淆

**注意**：as if 后可接真实或虚拟语气。

**Inversion after negative adverbs**（否定副词倒装）

**用法**：Never, rarely, seldom, hardly, scarcely, no sooner 放句首时部分倒装。

**例句**：
- Never have I seen such a thing.
- Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
- No sooner had I left than the phone rang.

**常见错误**：
- 倒装时主语与助动词位置未换
- no sooner 后接 than 与 when 混淆

**注意**：hardly...when；no sooner...than。

**Inversion after 'so/such...that'**（so/such...that 倒装）

**用法**：So + adj/adv + that... 放句首时部分倒装。

**例句**：
- So beautiful was the view that we stayed for hours.
- Such was the weather that we stayed indoors.
- So quickly did he run that I couldn't catch him.

**常见错误**：
- so 引导倒装时主语位置错误
- such 后接名词时倒装错误

**注意**：So + adj/adv + 助动词 + 主语 + that。

**Ellipsis**（省略）

**用法**：避免重复，省略主语、助动词、动词或名词。

**例句**：
- I like coffee, but she doesn't. (省略 like coffee)
- Are you coming? Yes, I am. (省略 coming)
- He can swim, but I can't.

**常见错误**：
- 省略后句子结构不完整
- doesn't 后省略内容错误

**注意**：省略需保持语法完整。

**Substitution: do / so / one**（替代）

**用法**：do/does 替代动词；so 替代从句；one 替代名词。

**例句**：
- I think so.
- I hope so.
- I prefer the red one.

**常见错误**：
- I think so 与 I think it 混淆
- do 替代 be 动词

**注意**：I think so / I hope so / I'm afraid so。

**Emphasis: cleft sentences**（强调句）

**用法**：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余。

**例句**：
- It was John who broke the window.
- It was yesterday that I saw her.
- It is in Paris that she lives.

**常见错误**：
- 强调句中漏 that/who
- 强调句中时态不一致

**注意**：强调句去掉 It is...that 后句子仍完整。

**Emphasis: What + noun clause**（what 引导名词性从句）

**用法**：What + 主语 + 动词，整体作主语/宾语。

**例句**：
- What I need is a break.
- What she said surprised me.
- What happened next was shocking.

**常见错误**：
- what 引导从句中再缺主语/宾语
- what 与 that 引导从句混淆

**注意**：what 在从句中充当成分，that 不充当。

grammar: Clauses of reason: because, since, as, for
description:
**Clauses of reason: because, since, as, for**（原因状语从句）

**用法**：because 直接原因；since/as 已知原因；for 书面补充说明。

**例句**：
- Because it rained, we stayed home.
- Since you're busy, I'll leave.
- As it was late, we went home.

**常见错误**：
- because 与 for 混用
- because 与 because of 混用

**注意**：because + 句子；because of + noun/gerund。

**Clauses of result: so/such...that**（结果状语从句）

**用法**：so + adj/adv + that；such + a/an + adj + noun + that。

**例句**：
- It was so hot that we stayed inside.
- She is such a good teacher that everyone loves her.
- He ran so fast that I couldn't catch him.

**常见错误**：
- so 与 such 结构混淆
- so 后接名词

**注意**：so + adj/adv；such + noun phrase。

grammar: Clauses of purpose: to / so that / in order to
description:
**Clauses of purpose: to / so that / in order to**（目的状语从句）

**用法**：to/in order to + 动词；so that/in order that + 从句。

**例句**：
- I went to bed early to get up at 6.
- He spoke slowly so that everyone could hear.
- In order to pass, she studied hard.

**常见错误**：
- so that 从句中用 will（应为 could/can）
- in order to 后接 -ing

**注意**：so that 从句常用 can/could/will/would。

**Clauses of concession: although/even though/while**（让步状语从句）

**用法**：although/even though 不与 but 连用；while 可表对比或让步。

**例句**：
- Although he is young, he is wise.
- Even though it was raining, we went out.
- While I understand, I disagree.

**常见错误**：
- although 与 but 同句
- while 表时间 vs. 让步混淆

**注意**：although 不能与 but 连用，但可与 yet/still 连用。

grammar: Clauses of condition: provided / as long as
description:
**Clauses of condition: provided / as long as**（条件状语从句）

**用法**：provided (that), as long as, unless 引导条件从句。

**例句**：
- I'll come provided you cook dinner.
- As long as you try, you'll succeed.
- You can go unless you finish your work.

**常见错误**：
- provided 后接 will
- as long as 与 if 完全等同

**注意**：provided/as long as 强调条件。

grammar: Clauses of time: by the time / the moment
description:
**Clauses of time: by the time / the moment**（时间状语从句）

**用法**：by the time, the moment, as soon as, immediately 引导时间从句。

**例句**：
- The moment I saw her, I knew.
- By the time you read this, I'll be gone.
- Call me as soon as you arrive.

**常见错误**：
- the moment 后接 will
- by the time 从句时态错误

**注意**：the moment/immediately 引导从句用一般现在时表将来。

grammar: Clauses of manner: as / as if / like
description:
**Clauses of manner: as / as if / like**（方式状语从句）

**用法**：as 表正如；as if 表好像；like 口语中表好像。

**例句**：
- Do as I say.
- He acts as if he knows everything.
- She sings like an angel.

**常见错误**：
- as if 与 like 在正式文体中混用
- as 与 like 完全等同

**注意**：正式写作中 as if 比 like 更被接受。

grammar: Noun clauses with that / if / whether
description:
**Noun clauses with that / if / whether**（名词性从句）

**用法**：that 引导陈述；if/whether 引导是否。

**例句**：
- I know that he is right.
- I wonder if she will come.
- I don't know whether to stay or go.

**常见错误**：
- whether 与 if 后接不定式时只能用 whether
- that 从句中再加疑问语序

**注意**：whether...or not；whether + to do。

**Noun clauses with question words**（疑问词引导名词性从句）

**用法**：what/where/when/why/how 引导名词性从句，用陈述语序。

**例句**：
- I don't know what he wants.
- Tell me where you live.
- I wonder how she did it.

**常见错误**：
- 名词性从句用疑问语序
- what 与 that 引导从句混淆

**注意**：疑问词在名词性从句中不引起倒装。

**Too / enough / so + adj + that**（too/enough/so 结构）

**用法**：too + adj + to do；adj + enough + to do；so + adj + that。

**例句**：
- It's too cold to go out.
- He isn't old enough to drive.
- It's so cold that we stayed in.

**常见错误**：
- enough 位置错误
- too 与 so 结构混淆

**注意**：too...to 表太……而不能。

**So + adj/adv + that**（so...that 结果从句）

**用法**：so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句。

**例句**：
- He was so tired that he fell asleep.
- She speaks so quickly that I can't follow.
- The book was so interesting that I read it in one day.

**常见错误**：
- so 后接名词
- that 从句中仍用 so

**注意**：so 强调形容词/副词，such 强调名词短语。

**Such + noun phrase + that**（such...that 结果从句）

**用法**：such + a/an + adj + 单数名词 + that；such + adj + 复数/不可数名词 + that。

**例句**：
- It was such a beautiful day that we went out.
- They are such good students that everyone likes them.
- It was such bad weather that we stayed home.

**常见错误**：
- such 后接 adj 时漏 a/an
- such 与 so 结构混淆

**注意**：such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that。

**Enough + noun / adj + enough**（enough 位置）

**用法**：enough + 名词（足够多）；形容词/副词 + enough（足够……）。

**例句**：
- We have enough time.
- He is old enough to vote.
- She runs fast enough.

**常见错误**：
- enough 放在形容词前
- enough 修饰名词时放在名词后

**注意**：enough 修饰名词可前置，修饰形容词/副词必须后置。

**Word order: adverbs**（副词位置）

**用法**：频率副词在 be 后/动词前；方式副词在句末；评论副词在句首。

**例句**：
- She always arrives on time.
- He speaks English fluently.
- Fortunately, no one was hurt.

**常见错误**：
- 频率副词放在句末（口语可）
- 方式副词放在动词与宾语之间

**注意**：He speaks English fluently. 不能放 He speaks fluently English.

**Word order: phrasal verbs**（短语动词词序）

**用法**：可分短语动词：名词可放中间或后面，代词必须放中间。

**例句**：
- Turn off the light. / Turn the light off. / Turn it off.
- Pick up your clothes. / Pick them up.

**常见错误**：
- 代词放短语动词后（*pick up it*）
- 名词只能放后面（错误）

**注意**：pick it up, turn it off, put them on。

**Word order: indirect questions**（间接疑问句词序）

**用法**：间接疑问句用陈述语序，助动词 do 不出现。

**例句**：
- Do you know where he lives?
- I wonder what she wants.
- Can you tell me how old she is?

**常见错误**：
- 间接疑问句用疑问语序
- 间接疑问句保留 do

**注意**：where does he live? → where he lives。

**Articles: review and advanced uses**（冠词复习与进阶）

**用法**：a/an 表泛指或首次；the 表特指或独一无二；零冠词用于抽象、泛复数、专有名词。

**例句**：
- Life is difficult. (零冠词)
- The life of a sailor is hard. (特指)
- I love music. (零冠词)

**常见错误**：
- 抽象名词前加 the
- 专有名词前加 the（特例除外）

**注意**：乐器前加 the：play the piano。

**Articles: places with/without the**（地名冠词）

**用法**：most countries/states/cities/towns/lakes 无 the；rivers/oceans/seas/mountain ranges 有 the。

**例句**：
- the United States, the Alps, the Pacific Ocean
- France, Tokyo, Lake Victoria
- the River Thames

**常见错误**：
- the + 国家名（多数国家不加）
- the + 湖泊名（多数不加）

**注意**：the + 复数国名/河流/海洋/山脉。

**Articles: school/prison/hospital/bed**（零冠词特殊用法）

**用法**：go to school（上学）/go to the school（去学校）意义不同。

**例句**：
- He went to hospital. (住院)
- He went to the hospital. (去医院办事)
- She is in bed. (睡觉)

**常见错误**：
- the 与零冠词意义不分
- 所有建筑前都加 the

**注意**：零冠词常表抽象功能。

**Quantifiers with countable/uncountable**（量词与可数/不可数）

**用法**：many/few/a few + 可数；much/little/a little + 不可数；a lot of/lots of/plenty of 两者皆可。

**例句**：
- Many students passed.
- Much time was wasted.
- Plenty of food was left.

**常见错误**：
- much 用于肯定句（通常用 a lot of）
- many 修饰不可数

**注意**：a lot of 最通用，much/many 多见于否定/疑问。

**All / both / neither / either / none**（all/both/neither/either/none 复习）

**用法**：all 全部，both 两者，neither 两者都不，either 任一，none 全无。

**例句**：
- All of the students passed.
- Neither answer is correct.
- None of them came.

**常见错误**：
- none 后接单数还是复数动词
- neither 与 none 范围混淆

**注意**：none of + 复数名词可用单数或复数动词。

**Each / every / all**（each/every/all 复习）

**用法**：each 强调个体，every 强调整体，all 表全部。

**例句**：
- Each child received a gift.
- Every child received a gift.
- All children received gifts.

**常见错误**：
- each 与 every 后接复数动词
- all 与 every 混用

**注意**：each/every + 单数动词；all + 复数动词。

**Another / other / the other / others**（another/other/others 复习）

**用法**：another 另一个；other 其他的；the other 特定另一个；others 其他人/物。

**例句**：
- I need another pen.
- Other people may disagree.
- Some like tea, others prefer coffee.

**常见错误**：
- another 与 other 混用
- others 与 the others 范围混淆

**注意**：another + 单数；other + 复数。

**One / ones / some**（one/ones/some 替代）

**用法**：one/ones 替代名词避免重复；some 替代复数名词。

**例句**：
- I prefer the blue one.
- I couldn't find any good ones.
- Some of my friends are doctors.

**常见错误**：
- one 替代不可数名词
- some 替代单数名词

**注意**：one 代替单数可数名词；some 代替复数或不可数。

grammar: So do I / Neither do I / I do too
description:
**So do I / Neither do I / I do too**（附和表达）

**用法**：So + 助动词 + 主语；Neither + 助动词 + 主语；I do too / I don't either。

**例句**：
- I love music. So do I.
- I don't like spinach. Neither do I.
- I like it. I do too.

**常见错误**：
- so/neither 后接主语位置错误
- I do too 用于否定句

**注意**：I do too 用于肯定；I don't either 用于否定。

**Formal vs. informal English**（正式与非正式英语）

**用法**：正式文体避免缩写、俚语，多用被动、名词化；非正式可随意。

**例句**：
- Formal: I would appreciate it if you could...
- Informal: Can you...?
- Formal: We regret to inform you that...

**常见错误**：
- 正式邮件用俚语
- 非正式场合用过于正式表达

**注意**：正式文体常用 shall, whom, whereas。

**Register: emails, letters, essays**（语域：邮件/书信/作文）

**用法**：不同文体用词、句式、称呼不同。

**例句**：
- Dear Sir/Madam, ... Yours faithfully...
- Hi ..., ... Best regards...
- In conclusion, ... On the one hand... On the other hand...

**常见错误**：
- 正式信结尾用 Cheers
- 作文用口语缩写

**注意**：Yours faithfully（未知姓名）；Yours sincerely（已知姓名）。

**Linking words: cause and effect**（因果连接词）

**用法**：because (of), due to, owing to, as a result, consequently, therefore, thus, hence。

**例句**：
- Due to the rain, the match was cancelled.
- Consequently, we arrived late.
- The flight was cancelled because of bad weather.

**常见错误**：
- due to 后接句子（应为名词）
- because 与 because of 混淆

**注意**：due to/owing to + noun；because + 句子。

**Linking words: contrast and comparison**（对比连接词）

**用法**：however, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, while, although, even though, despite, in spite of。

**例句**：
- While some people agree, others don't.
- In spite of the rain, we went out.
- On the other hand, it could be expensive.

**常见错误**：
- despite 后接句子（应为名词/动名词）
- although 与 despite 同句

**注意**：despite/in spite of + noun/gerund。

**Linking words: addition and sequencing**（递进与顺序连接词）

**用法**：furthermore, moreover, in addition, besides, firstly, secondly, finally。

**例句**：
- Firstly, we need to plan. Secondly, we need to execute. Finally, we review.
- Moreover, the cost is high.
- Besides, I don't have time.

**常见错误**：
- firstly 与 at first 混淆
- furthermore 与 however 混淆

**注意**：firstly/secondly/finally 用于列举。

**Essay structure and cohesion**（作文结构与衔接）

**用法**：introduction-body-conclusion；topic sentence, supporting sentences, concluding sentence。

**例句**：
- In this essay, I will discuss...
- On the one hand... On the other hand...
- In conclusion, ...

**常见错误**：
- 缺少主题句
- 段落之间无过渡

**注意**：一个段落一个中心思想。

**Describing trends**（描述趋势）

**用法**：上升：rise, increase, go up；下降：fall, decrease, go down；稳定：remain stable。

**例句**：
- Sales increased sharply in 2020.
- Prices remained stable.
- There was a dramatic fall in unemployment.

**常见错误**：
- trend 与 tendency 混用
- 形容词与副词在描述趋势中混淆

**注意**：increased sharply（动词+副词）；a sharp increase（形容词+名词）。
